messages:
Priya (Legal): quick legal request: CSV exports for bulk retention edits must include previous values and actor email. Current export only has new values.
Marco (PM): noted. Proposed CSV headers: resource_id, region_id, prev_retention_days, new_retention_days, actor_email, action_timestamp_utc, reason, cascade_applied.
Lena (Design): UI suggestion: add an optional checkbox in the bulk modal 'Include previous values in export' and default to ON for compliance orgs.
Diego (Frontend): backend needs to return prev values in payload. Acceptable, will add flag to API. Also ensure export filename includes UTC date.
Eli (Security): audit event wording should be explicit and include region: e.g., 'Applied retention policy: 90 days (prev: 30) 12 resources 024-05-02 18:03 UTC 1 actor: priya@example.com'.
Tara (A11y): accessibility notes: announce item count in modal with aria-live, and ensure the modal focus trap doesn't steal focus from screen reader users. Exports link should have aria-describedby explaining columns.
Priya (Legal): add 'reason' field (optional) in modal; it must persist to CSV and audit log.
Marco (PM): mobile: preview collapses to '12 items 1 Tap to expand' 0 ensure the expand control is keyboard-accessible.
Diego (Frontend): will implement checkbox, aria-live summary, and CSV headers. ETA: Friday PR.
ops-bot: retention-export-schema-v2 scheduled to run in staging at 2024-05-03T02:00Z. Logs: https://ops.redwood/app/logs/retention-export-v2
Priya (Legal): thanks, will review Friday.
